name: Ginny & Georgia
description: Free-spirited Georgia and her two kids, Ginny and Austin, move north in search of a fresh start but find that the road to new beginnings can be bumpy.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Georgia Miller arrives in the quaint New England town of Wellsbury with her daughter, Ginny, and her son, Austin, and quickly makes a big impression.

videos.title: It's a Face Not a Mask
videos.overview: As Ginny struggles to fit in with her new friends, she faces fallout from a night with Marcus. Georgia helps problem-solve for both Paul and Ellen.

videos.title: Next Level Rich People Shit
videos.overview: During the Sophomore Sleepover, Max bares her heart, Georgia resorts to old, bad habits, and Ginny shares connections with both Hunter and Marcus.

videos.title: Lydia Bennet Is Hundo a Feminist
videos.overview: Hunter's aloofness makes Ginny insecure. Max obsesses over a new love interest. Georgia sells Paul on an idea for a fundraiser — then has to deliver.

videos.title: Boo, Bitch
videos.overview: As Ginny's popularity grows, so do her questions about her own identity. After his night out with Georgia, Paul finds he has new political competition.

videos.title: I'm Triggered
videos.overview: Unplanned visitors cause headaches for Georgia and trust issues for Ginny, as more of Georgia's checkered past is brought to light.

videos.title: Happy Sweet Sixteen, Jerk
videos.overview: On Ginny's 16th birthday, Georgia tries to smooth things over by organizing a surprise party for her — but Ginny and her friends have other big plans.

videos.title: Check One, Check Other
videos.overview: Ginny draws inspiration from her dad when writing an essay she hopes to submit to a prestigious contest — but the result breeds friction with Hunter.

videos.title: Feelings Are Hard
videos.overview: While Ginny and Georgia both find themselves caught between two men, Max and Marcus face painful situations of different sorts.

videos.title: The Worst Betrayal Since Jordyn and Kylie
videos.overview: As election day approaches for Paul, secrets start to catch up with Ginny and Georgia — and the fallout for both could be steep.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Bitches!
videos.overview: The kids spend Thanksgiving with Zion, who helps Ginny through an emotional ordeal. Georgia has an awkward dinner with Paul's parents.

videos.title: Why Does Everything Have to Be So Terrible, All the Time, Forever?
videos.overview: Georgia worries Nick will reveal what he knows as she schemes her way up the Wellsbury social ladder. At school, Ginny gets an icy reception.

videos.title: What Are You Playing at, Little Girl?
videos.overview: After plotting revenge on a school mom, Georgia opens up about her troubled past to Ginny. Paul moves in with the Millers.

videos.title: Happy My Birthday to You
videos.overview: Paul and Georgia clash over her parenting style, Ginny throws a rager, and Cynthia finds love in an unexpected place.

videos.title: Latkes Are Lit
videos.overview: After a night out with Zion, Paul comes home to a startling discovery. Austin receives a surprise visitor at school.

videos.title: A Very Merry Ginny & Georgia Christmas Special
videos.overview: Sparks fly as Paul and Zion's families join the Millers for a holiday dinner. Austin looks for his Christmas gifts — and makes a dangerous find.

videos.title: Let Us Serenade the Sh*t Out of You
videos.overview: Georgia insists on going to Ginny's therapy session, where raw truths emerge. Gil pushes his way into Austin's life and Georgia finds cause to celebrate.

videos.title: Hark! Darkness Descends!
videos.overview: After a sudden behavior change raises concern among his friends, Marcus has a tearful meeting with Ginny. Austin witnesses a terrifying scene.

videos.title: Kill Gil
videos.overview: A buried secret comes to light. Joe and Georgia reminisce. An already heartbroken Ginny overhears upsetting news.

videos.title: I'm No Cinderella
videos.overview: As Gil continues to make threats and Cordova closes in, revelations about Georgia's past surface at the worst possible time.

videos.title: This Wouldn't Even Be a Podcast
videos.overview: With all of Wellsbury abuzz about her arrest, Georgia's history of lies threatens to unravel. Facing personal struggles, Ginny and Marcus reconnect.

videos.title: Beep Beep Freaking Beep
videos.overview: Georgia and her attorney spar over defense strategy. As Ginny finds a creative way to channel her feelings, Zion weighs what's best for his daughter.

videos.title: Friends Can Dance
videos.overview: Old sparks — and heartaches — reignite at the school's spring dance. Austin faces rejection in the classroom, while Paul weathers turmoil at the office.

videos.title: The Bitch Is Back
videos.overview: As jury selection begins, Georgia puts her keen observational skills to good use. An impulsive decision jeopardizes Marcus' future.

videos.title: Boom Goes the Dynamite
videos.overview: An explosive testimony transforms the trial. To distract herself from her home life, Ginny connects with an intriguing outsider.

videos.title: At Least It Can't Get Any Worse
videos.overview: Cut off from support, Georgia hits an emotional rock bottom. Paul's political challenges mount. To ease the tension, Max summons her BFFs.

videos.title: That's Wild
videos.overview: Desperate to speak with her mom, Ginny relies on Max and Sophie to clear the way. Gil tries to win Austin's trust.

videos.title: Is That a Packed Lunch
videos.overview: As the prosecution rests, a dramatic shift in the case raises the stakes for Georgia. Ginny opens up to her dad and opens doors with her writing.

videos.title: It's Time for My Solo
videos.overview: Georgia welcomes an unlikely advocate in the courtroom. As the curtain rises on the school musical, emotions run high and painful secrets emerge.

videos.title: Monsters
videos.overview: With Georgia's freedom on the line, the trial reaches a dramatic conclusion. Ginny takes a page from her mom's playbook.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 5 wins & 8 nominations total
